long_term_goal: GPT-grade general language understanding without an external LLM reasoning dependency
implemented: typed event records that keep event time separate from dialogue report turn
typed before, simultaneous, and during relations with explicit active or contested status
English and Korean temporal relation extraction for before, after, while, during, and sequential deictic forms
symbolic relative-day and relative-week expressions, ISO and Korean dates, and English or Korean clock times
bounded cross-turn event reuse for after that, then, and Korean equivalents
direct and transitive before-path question answering with relation-level proof evidence
bilingual when, before, after, during, and relation-check questions
entity-aware event retrieval that prevents predicate-only false matches
opposite-order conflict preservation without selecting a temporal winner
event, relation, answer, endpoint, authority, truth, and unsupported-claim tamper rejection
presupposition-aware fallback to discourse QA when a when-question lacks an actual timed event
deterministic evidence-grounded Korean and English temporal realization

architecture.statement_path: normalized utterance -> bounded bilingual temporal analysis -> typed events and relations -> validated temporal graph
architecture.question_path: normalized question -> typed temporal query -> entity-aware graph retrieval -> direct or transitive relation proof -> bilingual realization
architecture.authority_path: dialogue event or relation record -> evidence citation only -> no world-truth or execution authority
architecture.planning_boundary: recognized temporal question -> no GoalIR planning, no semantic plan hash, no task frame, no new belief

development_counterexamples.observed: The phrase day after tomorrow was captured by the shorter tomorrow marker and normalized to +1 day.
development_counterexamples.repair: Applied longest temporal-expression precedence so multi-token relative dates normalize before their suffixes.

development_counterexamples.observed: The initial temporal QA path answered presuppositional when-questions about absent or merely possible events, regressing two R10 abstention cases.
development_counterexamples.repair: Delegated absent, untimed, and exclusively non-actual event-time questions to the presupposition-aware discourse QA path.

development_counterexamples.observed: A question about migration finished could match backup completed because the event predicates were treated as sufficient retrieval terms.
development_counterexamples.repair: Required entity-bearing terms to match when present, while retaining bounded predicate compatibility for the same entity.

development_counterexamples.observed: Opposite temporal orders can both appear in dialogue evidence.
development_counterexamples.repair: Marked both relations contested and stored a conflict record instead of choosing one order or constructing an active cycle.

known_limits: Temporal recognition uses a bounded deterministic bilingual grammar rather than a general tense, aspect, and event-semantics parser.
Relative days and weeks remain symbolic offsets; they are not anchored to a calendar, locale, or time zone.
Duration and interval containment are relational only; quantitative interval arithmetic is not implemented.
Exact recurring event mentions within the bounded merge window can be conflated when no distinguishing time or event identity is supplied.
Event identity, nominal-event paraphrase, long-distance coreference, and implicit temporal relation recovery remain limited.
The graph records what the dialogue says and deliberately does not verify that an event happened in the external world.
Temporal conflict handling preserves disagreement but does not estimate source reliability or select a most likely timeline.
No broad open-domain corpus, human calibration study, or frontier-model comparison has been run.
The system remains below GPT-grade breadth, robustness, knowledge, and calibration.
next_frontier: verified conditional-guard activation without reverse inference or accidental execution authority
long-distance actor, entity, event, and belief-holder coreference across mixed Korean and English turns
compositional paraphrase and ontology-mediated event retrieval instead of bounded surface lexemes
causal, concessive, and purpose relations with explicit proof paths and source attribution
quantified and multi-hop relational questions with calibrated abstention
larger family-held-out adversarial dialogue suites and human-calibrated evaluation
